articles.summary: ST. LOUIS --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Jul. 1, 2026-- Reinsurance Group of America, Incorporated (NYSE: RGA), a leading global life and health reinsurer, announced today that Maurice Tulloch has been appointed to the company’s Board of Directors, effective July 1, 2026.
articles.title: Reinsurance Group of America Names New Member to Board of Directors
